description: Run one read query on a Helix database and return its JSON response. query_json is a Helix v3 JSON request, such as {"request_type":"read","query":{"read":{"entries":[{"query":{"name":"users","root":{"count":{"input":{"nodes_where":{"predicate":{"eq":{"left":{"property":"$label"},"right":{"constant":{"string":"User"}}}}}}}}}}],"returns":["users"]}}} (how many User nodes there are). Datetime props are Helix DateTime: filter them with a date_time parameter (declared in parameter_types) or {"constant":{"date_time":<ms>}}; text never matches. Its grammar is at https://docs.helix-db.com/database/helix-db/core-concepts/overview.

database.description: The database: tenant:<id> or cluster:<id>, as helix_list_databases or a Foundry ontology's database names it.

query_json.description: The complete Helix v3 JSON request, as a string: request_type read or write, and query holding one batch of that kind.

name: helix_execute_read_query
title: Run a read query
